Category: Geography / Culture

Overview

The Grimwild is a "points of light" setting.
Kingdoms may claim mountains, valleys, and regions, but they only truly control their capitals, main roads, inns along those roads, and checkpoints and fortresses.

Details

Go a mile or two off the beaten path and you're in the wild.
Maps are not very good.
The roads are relatively secure; off-road is dangerous.

What's in the wild:

  • Remnants of the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.yAiIJMlC7flCgMRm]{Old Empire}
  • Ruins of the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.BgvmBR3xqE7I4SUZ]{Middle Kingdoms}
  • People who don't fit civilization
  • Monsters that have cropped up
  • The unknown

Related Entries

  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.bEFUlWN5ttWk0y59]{Beaconhold} — A modern kingdom that exemplifies this pattern
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.yAiIJMlC7flCgMRm]{Imperium Lucis Aeternae} — The fallen empire whose remnants dot the landscape
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.BgvmBR3xqE7I4SUZ]{Middle Kingdoms} — The confederacy whose ruins are also found in the wild
